Import the purchases a provider recorded before Voidhash was connected, in the background. Stripe
and payment sources list their own history. The App Store and Google Play list no app's purchases,
so their import takes a CSV file (--file) whose first line names the columns: transaction_id (App
Store) or purchase_token (Google Play), one purchase per line, and optionally app_user_id, your id
for the buyer. Running it again skips what is recorded; --watch follows it, --report writes what
became of each purchase, --cancel stops it.

Usage:
  voidhash provider import [provider] [flags]

Arguments:
  provider  The provider: app-store, google-play, stripe, a payment source's slug or name, or its id

Flags:
      --cancel             Stop the running import instead; what it recorded stays
      --environment <production|test>
                           Which purchases: production (default) or test, such as Stripe's test
                           mode, a payment source's test payments, the App Store's sandbox or Google
                           Play's license testers
      --file <file>        App Store and Google Play: the CSV file of purchases to import
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --report <report>    App Store and Google Play: write what became of each purchase to this CSV
                           file (with --watch, once the import ends)
      --watch              Follow the import until it ends

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider import stripe --watch
  voidhash provider import paddle --environment test
  voidhash provider import app-store --file subscribers.csv --watch --report report.csv
  voidhash provider import google-play --file tokens.csv
  voidhash provider import stripe --cancel
